people.name: Amaw
people.line: A place near the Euphrates River, associated with Balaam.

people.name: Balaam
people.line: A prophet hired to curse Israel but blessed them instead.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Euphrates
people.line: Major river in ancient Near East; boundary of Promised Land

people.name: Pethor
people.line: The hometown of Balaam in Mesopotamia

translations.web: He sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor, to Pethor, which is by the River, to the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, “Behold, there is a people who came out of Egypt. Behold, they cover the surface of the earth, and they are staying opposite me.
translations.bsb: he sent messengers to summon Balaam son of Beor at Pethor, which is by the Euphrates in the land of his people. “Behold, a people has come out of Egypt,” said Balak. “They cover the face of the land and have settled next to me.

translations.asv: And he sent messengers unto Balaam the son of Beor, to Pethor, which is by the River, to the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, Behold, there is a people come out from Egypt: behold, they cover the face of the earth, and they abide over against me.
